contracts: LegacyDateTime day/fraction temporal order maps to a conservative interval in native serial order without civil conversion or payload canonicalization.
Inclusive equal points preserve epoch aliases and signed zero; other ranges retain complete boundary days and may include extra rows. Caller residual filtering remains mandatory.
All/Null remain distinct from unbounded non-NULL candidates, and every typed request still requires a qualified single legacy DATE key.
Native authored controls cover Jet 4 and ACE 2007/2016/2019 header profiles and both directions, selected residual answers, projected one-row ceilings and sequential table-order reads.
Wrong carriers/compound keys, corrupt selected roots and malformed hidden DATE payloads refuse; cancellation and independent byte limits retain typed failures.
Existing native entry/key validation, resource controls and write gates are reused without new dependencies or source caches.
source_snapshot_scope: Reviewed final working-tree files before logical commit; not a complete executable compilation manifest.
limits: No query extraction or automatic Access source integration yet.
Native reader evidence uses independently authored fixture bytes; original-file candidate replay is separate.
No native Microsoft Access SQL, new foreign-key/write eligibility, live-file coherence or timing qualification.
